messages:
maya: Quick check — NL-west (nl-west-1) governance/readiness. Need owners for: KMS key replication, SIEM/log routing, DB read-replica, routing policy + canary plan, legal DPA. Can owners confirm blockers and ETAs?

sam: KMS/infra here. There's an outstanding issue w/ regional KMS replication across accounts. PR #432 is out (cloud-kms:enable-replication). ETA Wed EOD if no further review. :eyes:

rao: SRE: routing policy ready, just need perf tests. Canaries planned for 1% traffic using traffic-weighted routing. I'll kick off canary after KMS is ready. Canary doc: https://go/redwood/infra/canary/nl-west

megan: Legal: still need completed data flow questionnaire + DPA addendum. I can draft the addendum if you paste a sample traffic flow and retention TTL. Also need confirmation on logs sent to vendor SIEM (yes/no).

jake: Runtime: model artifacts good. Note: quantized weights for gpt-large can't be replicated to eu/na keys unless license flag set. Who's owning license check? If we can't, fallback is hosted model variant.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary job started: canary-234 (nl-west) -> 10 instances. Status: provisioning...

maya: Action items:
- @sam: finish PR #432 + post KMS key arn
- @rao: hold canary until KMS ARN posted, then start 1% traffic
- @megan: I'll DM sample flow for addendum, please loop in legal
- @jake: confirm license flag or list fallback model variant

Quick test commands:
```
# routing check
curl -H "Host: api.redwood.ai" -H "X-Region: nl-west-1" https://routing-check.redwood.ai/health
# expect: {"region":"nl-west-1","route":"nl-west-cluster"}
```

sam: Posted KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456:key/abcd-ef12. PR merged. :thumbsup:

rao: Starting canary now. Will post results in ~20m.

megan: Got sample flow, filing addendum draft. ETA tomorrow morning.

jake: License flagged: not allowed for quant weights. Fallback model is redwood/gpt-large-1.0/float32. I'll add to rollout policy.

maya: Thanks all. Will compile checklist and ping execs if no blockers in 24h. :robot_face:
